pages.text: FORMAT turns a value into text with a format string. $(1)%d$() is a whole number, $(1)%f$() a decimal number and $(1)%s$() any value. A number between $(1)%$() and the letter sets the width.
For TIME values, $(1)%tF$() gives the date and $(1)%tT$() the time, like $(1)2026-10-19$() and $(1)14:05:09$(). Many more codes exist, such as $(1)%tA$() for the name of the weekday.
